drift.note: CONSTANT (unlike v1): 138.00 BPM from bar 1 to the end; kick onsets fit one straight line to 2.6 ms rms (bars 33-150), the drumless intro arp comb sits on the same line, every 16-bar block averages 137.99-138.03 BPM.
drift.warning: A constant 138.00 BPM grid from 0.126 s is within ~4 ms of beats[] everywhere, but still use beats[] / bars[]; Suno's 135 BPM would be off by 6.2 s.

tempo.meter: 4/4, four-on-the-floor where drums play; bar 1 beat 1 = 0.126 s; 8-bar phrases throughout (every section starts on bar 8n+1)

key.estimate: B minor (relative D major very prominent)
key.evidence: same harmony as v1. Harmonic-stem (other+bass) chroma: D major r=0.78 / B minor r=0.749 (same key signature, 2 sharps); verse blocks best-fit B minor, chorus blocks D major colour. No modulation.

beat_grid.convention: beats[i]: i from 0, bar = i//4+1, beat = i%4+1. zone: anchored = fitted to drum-stem kick onsets (drum sections) or to the plucked-arp onset comb (drumless sections); interpolated = no rhythmic anchor within +-2 beats (15.3-20.1, 56.6-61.9, 202.7-221.9 = end of Verse 2 + pad-only Chorus 2, 224.0-235.8, 265.8-278.8 = pads after the last hit; tempo is metronomic so the drift there is negligible); extrapolated = after 278.8 s.
beat_grid.verification: kick onsets vs grid residual rms 2.8 ms (p95 5.1 ms); arp-comb anchors rms 2.3 ms; downbeat phase matches beat_this downbeats in 148/155 cases (the 7 others are bars 80-85, all phase 2); section-start hits after long interpolated stretches land within 0-4 ms of the grid (bar 129 222.73, bar 137 236.64, bar 153 264.465).

sections.name: Intro
sections.description: Pads + plucked arp fading in with an opening filter (mix > -40 dBFS from 0.44 s; brightness 840 -> 2300 Hz over bars 1-6). Bar 5 (7.08): soft hat/snare pattern enters. Bar 9 (14.05): kick hit + rolling bass (bass already from bar 7 beat 3, 11.4). Bars 13-16: bass out, pads; a sustained low tone (~D4) in both vocal stems swells 23.2 -> 28.5 (see adlibs). No lyric.

parts.name: Intro A - pads/arp fade-in, hat pattern from bar 5
Intro B - kick hit + rolling bass (bar 9), pads from bar 13

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.description: Kick/bass hit on bar 17 (27.97); soft low vocal starts 28.54 (bar 17 beat 2.4). No steady drums. Bass under the verse.

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
sections.description: Vocal pickup "And every" starts 54.66 (bar 32 beat 2.5) - 1.1 s BEFORE the bar line. Bass out from bar 34 beat 4. Kick hit on bar 37 (62.72) under the held "from"; filter riser 64.9 -> 69.7 (bars 38-40).

sections.name: Chorus 1
sections.description: Hit on bar 41 (69.685); "Merge" scoops in at 69.42, 0.27 s before the bar. Stripped chorus: no steady kick; one more kick hit at 89.80 (bar 52, under "Nothing"). Bass bars 41-53, out from bar 54. Last line now "Nothing that I lived can come undone" ("undone" held to ~99.9).

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.description: Hit/crash on bar 57 (97.515). Strings/pads; "Branch... and wander..." 102.65, "Merge... and return..." 109.43; wordless "Ahh... ahh..." 111.87-125.9. Second half (bars 65-72) is a BUILD: kick hit + 16th hats from bar 65 (111.42), snare crescendo from 116.64, 32nd-note snare roll bar 72 (123.49-124.92). Same arrangement as v1, ~0.6 s earlier.

parts.name: Breakdown B - first build: hats + snare crescendo under "Ahh"

sections.name: Build Up
sections.description: Full kick + bass slam on bar 73 (125.34, strongest bar-line onset of the song). Four-on-the-floor groove bars 73-85, NO VOCAL (the v1 whispered "One repo per agent / Per session, per life" is gone; RoFormer vocal stem < -50 dB 127-172 s). Bar 86 (147.95): bass out, kick fades (-14 -> -40 dB) while snare/hats continue; mix brightens (riser) into the drop. Unlike v1 there is no full drums-out gap.

parts.name: Build Up A - full-drum groove (impact 125.34), no vocal
Build Up B - bass out, kick fading, snare build + riser

sections.name: Instrumental Drop
sections.description: DROP IMPACT 153.17 (bar 89 downbeat). Full kick/bass + lead + strings. NEW in v2: a sustained wordless "ooh" layer in the vocal stems 173.08-180.9 (bars 100-104, no consonants; adlib, not a lyric). Bass out bar 104 beat 3 (178.6); 16th snare fill 179.68-180.99 into Verse 2.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.description: Impact on bar 105 (180.99), vocal 182.00. Improvised high melody (high notes on THE 185.30, I 190.57, THAT 197.12 held to 198.1, BE 204.38). Sung OVER full drums bars 105-116; drums + bass cut at bar 117 (201.86) for the last line.

sections.name: Chorus 2
sections.description: NO hit on bar 121 (208.82): pads only, no kick and no bass until bar 129. "Merge" scoops in at 208.13 out of the held "again"; "ME" emphasised (210.96). Kick/snare pickup 222.48 -> hit + bass return on bar 129 (222.73). Filter riser bars 135-136 (233.2-236.6). Last line now "Every life I've lived, I have become".

sections.name: Outro
sections.description: "Back to main" #1 is a pickup at 235.75 (end of Chorus 2). Bar 137 (236.64) full-drum outro drop; "main" held to 238.65 + wordless vocalise 238.66-248.97; "Back to main" #2 at 249.44, "main" held to ~255.9. Drums + bass out bar 149 (257.51): arp alone. Riser into bar 153: kick + bass hit 264.465, arp stops, then pads + bass sustain, fade to < -40 dBFS at 282.45. Only TWO "Back to main" (v1 had a third, low one) and NO final hit at bar 161 (v1 had one).

parts.name: Outro A - final drop with held vocal
Outro B - drums out, arp alone
Outro C - last hit, pads + bass, fade

lyrics.method: Known lyric text force-aligned per line on the vocal stems with 4 CTC runs (torchaudio MMS_FA + wav2vec2-large-960h, each on demucs htdemucs_ft and BS-RoFormer vocals; median start) cross-checked with stable-ts/whisper-large-v3 alignment; starts snapped to syllable onsets (energy/pitch) within -90/+50 ms; sibilant onsets backtracked to the start of frication; line starts and ambiguous words corrected by visual inspection of spectrogram + pitch panels (work_v2/overrides.json). Word ends = next word start, or the end of the sustained note (RoFormer RMS > max(peak-20, -40) dB).

lines.text: I split myself a thousand ways
Down every road the night could hold
Each one a light I sent ahead
Each one a story to unfold
And every branch remembers
Where I started from
Merge me back to main
Every road I ran becomes the one
Fold me in again
Nothing that I lived can come undone
Branch... and wander...
Merge... and return...
Ahh... ahh...
lines.note: Wordless: no aligner/ASR output. Same melody as v1, ~0.65 s earlier. Ahh #1 = drop to B3 right after 'return' (111.87, bar 65 beat 2), leaps at 114.06 and 116.69; Ahh #2 = leap to F#5 at 118.36 (bar 69 downbeat), held and fading out by ~125.9 (< -40 dB from ~124.8). Boundary 'return'/Ahh #1 is musical, not phonetic (medium-low confidence).

lines.text: This branch may never find the way
lines.note: 173.08-180.9 sustained flat 'ooh' tone in both vocal stems is NOT this line (see adlibs)

lines.text: Back to the place where I began
And maybe something that I learned
lines.note: improvised: 'some-thing THAT' held on the high note 196.4-198.1; 'I' = drop to the low note 198.12; MMS CTC squeezed that/I/learned into 196.95-197.27 (wrong), wav2vec2 agrees with the inspection

vs_lyric_sheet: Every sheet line is sung once, in order, with the sheet words (ASR mishearings such as "Chained/Wrench and wander", "back to lane/Maine", "This dance", "something that I love" are breathy-vowel artefacts; the sung text matches the sheet).
"Back to main..." is sung TWICE (235.75, 249.44) - the sheet line, plus the end-of-chorus pickup; v1 had three.
Unlisted wordless vocalise 238.66-248.97 between "Back to main" #1 and #2 (continuous with the held "main").
"Ahh... ahh..." = two long wordless notes 111.87-118.33 and 118.36-125.9 (leap to F#5 on bar 69); no consonants, boundary to "return" is musical.
The build-up whispers of v1 are gone (no vocal at all 127-172 s in the RoFormer stem).
Unlisted: low sustained tone in the vocal stems 23.2-28.5 before the first line, and a wordless "ooh" layer 173.08-180.9 in the drop (adlibs, lip_sync false).
Verse 2 improvisation: high notes on THE (185.30-185.85), I (190.57), THAT (197.12-198.11, held), BE (204.38-205.0). Chorus 2 "ME" emphasised (210.96).
No extra chorus repeats; choruses are not doubled.

spot_check.method: independent onset on the demucs vocal stem (steepest 2-8 kHz or broadband rise, backtracked) vs predicted start; |err|>90 ms cases are b/p words (place, become) where the prediction marks lip closure and the measure marks the burst/vowel
